headline: Morningstar has launched Direct AI, a version of its investment research platform with three AI agents, and has opened its research to Claude, Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: the launch was on 7 Oct, before the window, and the article carries the company's own claims.
importance_line: Fund managers and advisers worldwide get AI agents built on Morningstar's ratings, but the benefits are the company's own claims and only one of the three agents is described.
summary: RankiaPro reports that Morningstar, the investment research firm, launched Direct AI on 7 Oct 2026, a redesigned version of its Morningstar Direct platform with AI agents for product development, distribution and manager research, built on its ratings and the work of more than 1,100 analysts. Morningstar also says its research will be reachable through Claude, Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT, and its Direct platform president says the quality of that data is what sets the offering apart.
notes: default_v1 MOD; chosen MKT because it is a finance-industry product (reasonable alternative MOD). Reads like Morningstar's announcement. Score 5 to 4.
